newsitem.title: USA: SVI Holdings says has no stock sale plans.
newsitem.headline: SVI Holdings says has no stock sale plans.

text.p: SVI Holdings Inc said on Monday it has not sold any of its common stock in a private placement, and it does not have any plans to do so.

The company added its present officers and directors have not sold stock either. In a statement, President Barry Schechter said he has been contacted by investors concerned about possible stock sales by the company or insiders.
Schechter added that he is unaware of any events which might have led to a drop in the share price of the investment holding company.
